Move 172 (splitting; Grodal, Anteby and Holm), D3a-01: R01's statement revised. Was: the starter, a member who proposes the mark, maps it or begins placing it, and whom others then join. Now: the starter, a member who proposes the mark, maps it or begins placing it; others joining is not part of the role but the answer to the room's call (P15), in the order A02 and A01 state. Caused by corrections met twice: Madeon-005, batman-016, futanari-009, androidgaming-013, hearthstone-008, hentai-003, katawashoujo-029, shitredditsays-004, tetris-005, transgender-005, vietnam-008 (six at T4-006, four of them at T3-033; three at T4-005 and T3-002). Warrant: every cited concept shows the starter's own act and none shows others joining that member; the range (from a member who only asks to one who places alone) already admitted these rooms, so the statement claimed more than its range, and joining is held by P15, A02 and A01. Range unchanged; no room enters or leaves the role; not a loosening. The revision is a rewritten element, so the rooms whose accounts rely on R01 go to the re-check (section 5); the scope is set when the re-check is built.

D3a-01, F-017 re-examined under rule 14 against move 172 (R01's joining clause split to P15, A02 and A01): a new findings.jsonl line supersedes F-017 with its statement, counts, bound and status unchanged, since F-017 counts members proposing the room's mark and R01 still names that member. findings.jsonl 37 lines.
